summary: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (not produced by IBM Bob). Shopfloor is an in-process checkout system: a gateway routes requests to auth, cart and checkout; checkout orchestrates inventory, payment and notifications; customer profiles and stock live in a shared datastore.

services.name: Gateway
services.responsibility: SYNTHETIC. Routes HTTP requests, assigns request ids and resolves sessions.

services.name: Auth
services.responsibility: SYNTHETIC. Password and SSO login, session lifecycle.

services.name: Customer
services.responsibility: SYNTHETIC. Loads and caches customer profiles and billing details.

services.name: Payment
services.responsibility: SYNTHETIC. Charges the customer's default card through the card processor.

services.name: Checkout
services.responsibility: SYNTHETIC. Orchestrates reserve, charge, confirm and compensation.

services.name: Ledger
services.responsibility: SYNTHETIC phantom service used to exercise the unverified state.

entryPoints.description: SYNTHETIC. Wires all services and exposes handle(req).

dataFlows.name: Checkout
dataFlows.description: SYNTHETIC. From POST /checkout to a confirmed order.
